context.problemStatement: Show 0.4 plus 0.3 on a number line.
context.solutionStrategy: Use the quantities given in the problem.
context.groundingProse: Start at zero, jump four tenths to 0.4, then three tenths to 0.7. Scale zero to one.
context.seedNotes: Draw both jumps on a scale marked in tenths.

content.altText: A number line from 0 to 1 divided into tenths, showing a jump of 0.4 from 0 to 0.4, followed by another jump of 0.3 landing at 0.7.

annotations.steps: I start at zero, make a jump of 0.4, and then make another jump of 0.3 to the right.
annotations.strategy: I notice that combining decimals on a number line works just like adding whole numbers by chaining the lengths together.
annotations.misconceptions: Start at the given number. Count the moves after it, not the starting mark.
